body: Make a square nine-panel holiday portrait sheet from the uploaded photo. Keep the same face, hairstyle and red knit outfit in every panel while varying natural expressions and playful hand poses. Use a plain ivory studio backdrop, subtle festive doodles and these nine exact short greetings, in reading order: {{greetings}}. Ensure each greeting is readable and the grid spacing is consistent.
